here...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's easier to focus in the dark. The 
scents... the tastes... temperature... 
sounds... they're easier to feel.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coffee tastes... so much more delicious 
when you can fully perceive every delicate 
nuance.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, thinking about things... or not 
thinking about anything... is easier... in 
the dark.
